name: acqflo-mcp
description: Connect Claude Desktop to AcqFlo. 60+ tools across deals, brokers, organizations, files, enrichment, scoring, and more — plus 8 underwriting workflow prompts.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to AcqFlo, the deal-pipeline platform for commercial real estate acquisition teams. This is a thin stdio→HTTP proxy that forwards to AcqFlo's MCP endpoint at /api/mcp-rpc; the server logic lives in the AcqFlo app and updates roll out without requiring a new bundle install. Authentication uses a personal API key generated in AcqFlo Settings → AI. Drop-in replacement for v1.0.x — same API key works.

api_key.title: AcqFlo API Key
api_key.description: Generate this in AcqFlo → Settings → AI → "Claude / MCP API Keys". Starts with mcp_.

acqflo_url.title: AcqFlo URL (optional)
acqflo_url.description: Override the AcqFlo base URL. Leave blank for production (https://acqflo.com). Useful for self-hosted or staging.
